title: Scientology flies Sheehan to Florida to court him as Hubbard's lawyer
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Scientology flies Sheehan to Florida to court him as Hubbard's lawyer, about 1970s at Clearwater, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so uh they flew me down to uh to Florida uh and the big blue cube they've got down there, this big huge blue building.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, says that in the 1970s the Church of Scientology tried to recruit him to work for its leader, L. Ron Hubbard. He says they flew him down to Clearwater, Florida, to their big blue building, which he calls the big blue cube. He tells it as part of his story of the powerful groups that tried to win him over.
